item.title: Megan Moroney Launches First Fragrance, ‘Calliope’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our latest episode, where we dive into the exciting world of music and entrepreneurship. Today, we're talking about country star Megan Moroney, who's just launched her debut fragrance, Calliope.
[Short music transition]
Host: Moroney is known for her vibrant visuals and stage shows, but now she's taking her artistic ventures to the next level with a fragrance that's as unique as she is. Calliope features notes of jasmine, pink peony, mineral musk, and peach blossom, making it a truly distinctive scent.
[Short music transition]
Host: But what really sets Calliope apart is its stunning packaging. The heart-shaped bottle is designed to look like it's been shattered and pieced back together with silver glitter, inspired by the Japanese art of kintsugi. And if you look closely, you'll notice the words "You Shine!" on the bottle, a nod to Moroney's hit song "Beautiful Things".
[Short music transition]
Host: Moroney has spent over a year crafting the concept, scent, and design of Calliope, and it shows. She believes that fragrance has the power to evoke emotions and memories, just like her music. As she says, "A scent can instantly take you back to a moment you thought you'd forgotten, capture a feeling you never want to let go of, or become forever tied to a season of your life."
[Short music transition]
Host: Calliope is now available for pre-order in the US, EU, and UK, with a 3.4-ounce bottle priced at $55. Moroney joins a long list of country artists who have launched their own fragrances, including Dolly Parton, Shania Twain, and Miranda Lambert.
[Short music transition]
Host: And if you're a fan of Moroney's music, you can catch her on her Cloud 9 Tour, which is currently making its way across the country. Her namesake album debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 earlier this year, so don't miss out on the chance to see her live.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
